services.title: Lock Rekeying & Installation

services.title: Commercial Lock Service
services.description: Office buildings, storefronts, warehouses. Master key systems and access control that actually works.

about.heading: One Call, One Guy, One Bill
about.body: We're the Myrtle Beach locksmith team that shows up when we say we will. No runaround, no hidden fees, no subcontractors.

reviews.name: Darlene S.
reviews.text: Rekeyed all our doors when we bought our new home. Friendly, quick to respond, professional, and affordable. Will absolutely call them again.

reviews.name: Cynthia W.
reviews.text: Showed up earlier than estimated when I was locked out. Changed the keyed entries fast and professionally! Great job and great guy!

reviews.name: Justin S.
reviews.text: Answered all my questions over the phone. Came to my apartment within 10 minutes and unlocked my door! Professional and way cheaper than expected!
